Any, as long as it works
file_size: What is the maximum plugin file size?

Strictly higher than the previous one
The same as the previous one

Published if the description warns about it

Allowed for your own contacts only

Only as an explicit setting that is off by default
If the author warns in the description

A clear advantage: new features, better stability, or the analog is abandoned
Nothing, the catalog already has similar ones
A different UI color is enough
abandoned: How long must an analog be un-updated to count as abandoned?
Over 4 months and partly broken on the current version
too_simple: A plugin changes a single UI color. Most likely:
Rejected — the task is too simple
Published if the code is clean
raw_impl: Great idea, but the plugin crashes and lags. Result:
Rejected — you may fix it and resubmit

Only if you mention it in the description

If the original author didn't reply within a day

Nothing if the code was rewritten
fork_cosmetic: A fork only renamed things and changed a color. This is:
Accepted if the original is old
decision: Moderators vote Yes/Reject stating a reason
after_reject: Your plugin was rejected. What does it mean?
Rejection ≠ ban: you may fix it and resubmit
The author is banned from the ecosystem
The plugin will never be accepted
You must wait a month before retrying
description: What must a plugin description contain?
What it does and how to use it — in Russian and/or English

Published if the author is known
